text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with glossy black hair in two buns, softly separated fringe and long face-framing strands, mint gray eyes and pale softly textured skin. Rose gold phoenix hairpins with delicate chains. Black high-collar fitted traditional fantasy dress, rose gold piping and floral fasteners, fine dark floral material pattern. The same black and rose-gold fitted dress extends into a continuous ankle-length subtly flared skirt, matching black embroidered low-heel shoes. Slim healthy tall 175 cm build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
